metadata.description: Action Base for Intention-Aware Dataset Grounding with Explicit Axes Specifications

axes_framework.description: Five-dimensional framework for table profiling across multiple analytical perspectives

schema.name: Schema
schema.description: Table structure, column types, and cardinality properties
schema.evaluation_method: Schema analysis and column type detection

temporal.name: Temporal
temporal.description: Time-series properties, date ranges, granularity, and continuity
temporal.evaluation_method: Temporal column detection and time-series analysis

statistical.name: Statistical
statistical.description: Data distribution, variance, nullness, and statistical properties
statistical.evaluation_method: Statistical descriptive analysis and quality metrics

quality.name: Quality
quality.description: Data completeness, consistency, accuracy, and reliability indicators
quality.evaluation_method: Data validation, duplicate detection, constraint checking

domain.name: Domain
domain.description: Domain relevance, business context, and semantic alignment
domain.evaluation_method: Semantic analysis, domain expert annotation, keyword matching

PREDICT.name: PREDICT
PREDICT.purpose: Forecast future outcomes based on historical patterns
PREDICT.description: Extract patterns from past data to make predictions about future events

temporal.specification: Table must have temporal column (date, year, timestamp) for time-series model building. Required for model training across time periods.

statistical.specification: Table must have measurable numeric outcome with meaningful variance. Requires sufficient statistical validity for forecasting. Minimum 100 rows for model stability.

schema.specification: Table must have outcome/target column (numeric or categorical) and at least 2 explanatory feature columns. Data types must be appropriate for ML (numeric or properly encoded categorical).

quality.specification: High data quality essential. Completeness must support model training (missing <20% per column). Data consistency across time periods required.

domain.specification: Columns should be semantically relevant to prediction domain. Domain relevance improves feature interpretation and model validity.

HC1.name: temporal_column
HC1.description: Table must have temporal column (date, year, timestamp)

HC2.name: outcome_column
HC2.description: Table must have outcome/target column (side effect, symptom, measurement)

HC3.name: explanatory_columns
HC3.description: Table must have at least 2 explanatory columns (features, dimensions)

HC4.name: data_volume
HC4.description: Table must have at least 100 rows for statistical validity

semantic.name: ψ_semantic
semantic.description: Column relevance to prediction domain (0-1 scale)

structural.name: ψ_structural
structural.description: Data types appropriate for prediction (0-1 scale)
structural.evaluation: Average score of: temporal (1.0 if DATE/TIMESTAMP, 0.5 if year, 0), outcome (0.75 if numeric, 0.25 if categorical), explanatory (0.5-1.0 mix)

coverage.name: ψ_coverage
coverage.description: Breadth of columns covering prediction domain (0-1 scale)
coverage.evaluation: Measure: demographics, environment, temporal range, outcome diversity

joinability.name: ψ_joinability
joinability.description: Ability to link with other tables (0-1 scale)
joinability.evaluation: Count joinable columns / potential join opportunities

weights.rationale: PREDICT prioritizes coverage (0.35) and quality (0.25) because forecasting needs complete, accurate feature sets. Joinability is low (0.05) because prediction is typically single-table.

COMPARE.name: COMPARE
COMPARE.purpose: Identify differences between groups or regions
COMPARE.description: Find and quantify differences in outcomes across multiple groups or time periods

schema.specification: Table must have grouping columns (region, country, vaccine type, demographic) with at least 2 dimensions. Must have measured outcome column (rate, count, percentage).

statistical.specification: Table must show variance across groups. Each group must have sufficient observations. Group cardinality must be at least 2 per dimension.

quality.specification: Data quality critical for fair comparison. Group balance essential (min_group_size / max_group_size > 0.1). Missing values should not bias groups.

temporal.specification: Optional temporal dimension for time-based comparisons (e.g., comparing trends across countries over time).

domain.specification: Columns should represent meaningful business/analytical dimensions for comparison.

HC1.name: grouping_column
HC1.description: Table must have grouping column (region, country, vaccine type, demographic)

HC2.name: measured_outcome
HC2.description: Table must have outcome/measured column (rate, count, percentage)

HC3.name: multi_dimensional_groups
HC3.description: Table must have at least 2 grouping dimensions

HC4.name: group_cardinality
HC4.description: Table must have at least 2 distinct groups per dimension

semantic.name: ψ_semantic
semantic.description: Column relevance to comparison domain (0-1 scale)

structural.name: ψ_structural
structural.description: Group column cardinality and clarity (0-1 scale)
structural.evaluation: Normalized cardinality: actual groups / expected maximum groups

coverage.name: ψ_coverage
coverage.evaluation: Count of distinct outcome measures / expected outcomes

quality.name: ψ_quality
quality.description: Group balance and data consistency (0-1 scale)

joinability.name: ψ_joinability
joinability.description: Ability to align groups across tables (0-1 scale)
joinability.evaluation: Count of group columns that match other tables / total group columns

weights.rationale: COMPARE prioritizes structural clarity (0.30) because meaningful comparison requires clear, distinct groups. Joinability (0.15) matters to validate comparisons across tables.

CORRELATE.name: CORRELATE
CORRELATE.purpose: Find relationships or dependencies between variables
CORRELATE.description: Identify statistical or logical associations between two or more variables

statistical.specification: Table must have at least 2 numeric/measurable columns with meaningful variance. Requires sufficient rows (min 50) for correlation validity. Each variable must show variation (not constant).

schema.specification: Table must have numeric or measurable columns. Data types must support correlation analysis (numeric, ordinal, or properly encoded categorical).

quality.specification: Data quality essential for valid correlations. Missing values should not create artificial patterns. Data consistency required across all variables.

domain.specification: Variables should have meaningful semantic relationship (not spurious correlations). Domain knowledge helps validate correlation findings.

HC1.name: min_variables
HC1.description: Table must have at least 2 numeric/measurable columns

HC2.name: sufficient_rows
HC2.description: Table must have at least 50 rows for correlation validity

HC3.name: variable_variance
HC3.description: Each variable must have meaningful variance (not constant)

SUMMARIZE.name: SUMMARIZE
SUMMARIZE.purpose: Describe current data or compute aggregates
SUMMARIZE.description: Create summaries, overviews, or aggregate statistics from data

schema.specification: Table must have at least 1 column suitable for aggregation (numeric, categorical, or temporal). Ideally has grouping columns for breakdown summaries.

statistical.specification: Table structure and row count affect summary meaningfulness. Variance in values makes summaries more informative.

quality.specification: Data completeness important for accurate aggregates. Missing values affect summary calculations. Consistency ensures reliable totals/averages.

domain.specification: Columns should represent business-meaningful metrics for summary reporting.

HC1.name: aggregatable_columns
HC1.description: Table must have at least 1 column suitable for aggregation

HC2.name: grouping_optional
HC2.description: Table should ideally have grouping columns (not strictly required)

EXPLAIN.name: EXPLAIN
EXPLAIN.description: Find causal or mechanistic explanations for observed phenomena

schema.specification: Table must have outcome/target column to explain. Must have at least 3 explanatory feature columns. Feature types should support causal analysis.

domain.specification: High domain relevance essential. Columns should map to domain concepts. Strong semantic alignment improves causal interpretation.

statistical.specification: Sufficient variance in features and outcome for causal patterns. Adequate row count for robust explanations.

quality.specification: Data quality critical for valid explanations. Consistency and completeness ensure reliable causal inference.

HC1.name: outcome_column
HC1.description: Table must have a target outcome to explain

HC2.name: feature_columns
HC2.description: Table must have at least 3 potential explanatory features

FILTER.name: FILTER
FILTER.purpose: Select subset of data based on criteria
FILTER.description: Extract rows or records matching specific conditions

schema.specification: Table must have filterable columns with meaningful values. Columns should have discrete values or ranges suitable for filtering.

quality.specification: Non-null values in filter columns essential. Missing values in filtering dimensions reduce result quality.

domain.specification: Filter columns should represent meaningful business/analytical dimensions.

HC1.name: filterable_columns
HC1.description: Table must have columns with meaningful values to filter on

JOIN.name: JOIN
JOIN.description: Link tables on common keys to create enriched dataset

schema.specification: Table must have at least one column suitable as join key. Join key should have reasonable cardinality (not all unique, not all identical). Additional enrichment columns benefit from structural diversity.

quality.specification: Join key must be reliable. Uniqueness and consistency of key values essential. Missing or duplicate key values reduce join quality.

domain.specification: Join columns should represent meaningful linkable entities. Semantic clarity improves join success.

HC1.name: join_key
HC1.description: Table must have at least one column that can serve as join key

HC2.name: key_uniqueness
HC2.description: Join key should have reasonable cardinality (not all unique, not all same)

metadata_extended.kb_growth_strategy: Phase 1: First-principles logical derivation of specifications. Phase 2: Expert validation against domain knowledge. Phase 3: Empirical tuning based on ranked-table usage feedback.
notes: Each action now explicitly specifies required axes and detailed axis specifications
Axis specifications include: required (boolean), critical (boolean for hard constraints), specification (text), and profile_properties (metrics to compute)
Profiler component can now use required_axes to determine which dimensional views to compute for each table
Critical axes are included in hard_constraints validation during grounding phase
